verdict.rationale: The only concrete evidence is one hands-on user report of controlling a Windows 10 machine from Linux with AnyDesk. That shows Windows and Linux clients exist and that host and viewer can run on different operating systems. No first-party docs list supported platforms, and a 2014 launch comment noted no Mac version was available then, which concerns an early release and doesn't contradict any current claim. Missing for 10: a documented platform matrix, evidence of mobile clients (iOS/Android), evidence of macOS support, and first-party confirmation of cross-OS sessions.
